Subject: POC: trial environment planning — hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC

Hi Tim,

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps for the POC/trial:

Success criteria (what ACME will measure):
- 95th percentile latency < 150ms for 1k token gen
- Sustained throughput of 50 req/s for batch scoring
- Cost target: <= $0.001 per generated token (as a guideline)
- No sensitive PII stored on our side; audit logging enabled

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff and environment provisioning
- Week 1: baseline perf on hosted sandbox (latency + throughput)
- Week 2: migrate to VPC trial for secure validation and integration tests
- Week 3: run production-like load tests and finalize success sign-off

Environment options (tradeoffs):
1) Hosted sandbox — fastest to start; shared control plane, good for perf baseline
2) Dedicated sandbox — reserved capacity; better isolation and predictable throughput
3) VPC trial — customer VPC peering or private endpoints; required for security-sensitive workloads

Ask for ACME before kickoff:
- Confirmation of the preferred trial path (hosted -> VPC staged approach recommended)
- S3 path to sample evaluation dataset & any redaction guidance
- Expected concurrency and peak qps
- Procurement contact for any paperwork

Proposed kickoff: Monday, 2027-05-24. I’ve attached the POC scope (poc_scope_of_work.pdf) — please review and confirm.

Next steps: if you confirm kickoff and provide the items above, we'll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with our SE (Dev Patel) to start provisioning.

Best,

Marissa Cole
